avoid_for: Dense operational dashboards, formal corporate sites, consumer retail with heavy photography, or any context needing sharp corners or screen-pure white — the cream broadsheet, 2px ink borders, oversized rounded chambers, and lavender CTA are a warm editorial voice that reads like a printed magazine rebuilt for software, not a neutral B2B page.
best_for: AI / productivity / speech-to-text software landing pages (dictation, writing tools, typing apps) that want an editorial broadsheet feel — cream and dark-velvet chambers, weight-400 EB Garamond display at 48–120px, oversized rounded corners, a soft lavender CTA, and waveform visualizers as signature graphics.
name: Wispr Flow
palette_voice: A disciplined four-color palette: warm Lumen Cream (#ffffeb) as the dominant canvas and light text, Vast Ink (#1a1a1a) as the near-black dark chambers and 2px borders, Lavender Whisper (#f0d7ff) for the primary CTA and accent surfaces, and Forest Ink (#034f46) teal for badges and secondary buttons on dark; Ember Glow orange (#ffa946) punctuates only active/live states. No gradients, no drop shadows — flat fills, 2px ink borders, and fill alternation (cream → dark → cream) do all the separation.
signature_moves: Cream and dark 'velvet chamber' sections alternating page-wide, each dark chamber bookended by cream, with oversized 40–80px border radii that make sections feel like rounded inset pebbles rather than elevated overlays
EB Garamond weight-400 display serif at 48–120px with 0.85–0.95 line-height — authority through sheer scale and tight leading, never bold; negative tracking (-3.6px at 120px)
The 2px solid Vast Ink border on every interactive element — the thick border is the signature, non-negotiable on the lavender CTA
Lavender Whisper (#f0d7ff) as the sole primary action color, echoed by hand-drawn lavender SVG squiggle underlines beneath 1–2 words in headlines to link emphasis and action

The waveform visualizer pill — cream pill with 2px ink border and 5–7 pulsing vertical bars — doubling as audio indicator and decorative rhythm marker; plus flat phone mockups and curved text arcs as the only graphics

source.radius: 32px cards, 12px buttons/inputs, 9999px badges/nav pill, 40–80px dark section chambers
source.shadow: none — deliberately shadowless, border-driven; no box-shadows, elevation is fill alternation + oversized radii

typographic_voice: A two-face system: EB Garamond (subst. Cormorant Garamond/Playfair) is the classical serif at weight 400 only, used at massive display sizes (32–120px) where scale commands and 0.85–0.95 line-height tightens lines into a single horizontal gesture; Figtree (subst. Inter/Plus Jakarta Sans/Manrope) is the geometric sans for all body, nav, buttons, and badges at weight 400 default with 500–700 for emphasis and a steady 1.3 line-height; never bold the serif display, never center body text, never use border-radius below 12px on buttons or 32px on cards.
